name: search-input

manifest.name: search-input
manifest.title: SearchInput
manifest.description: A search box on InputGroup and Base UI's Input: a search icon, type="search", and a Clear button (and Escape) while there is text, in three density-aware sizes.
manifest.usage: Use SearchInput to filter or search a list as the user types: tables in a schema browser, rows of a result, settings. Name it with a FieldLabel or an aria-label ("Search tables"); the placeholder is not a name. Wire value and onValueChange (called with "" when cleared) and announce the result count in a role="status" element. Escape clears the text, and only passes through when there is nothing to clear. For a query that runs on Enter only, use it the same way and act in onKeyDown; for picking one option from a list, use Combobox.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called on every change, with "" when cleared.

props.name: size
props.description: Height from size.control.*, which follows data-density.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: A hint shown while empty; not a label.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the input and hides the Clear button.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Focusable, cannot be changed or cleared.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the frame, merged after the component's own.

slots.name: root
slots.description: The InputGroup frame; data-slot="search-input" and data-size.

slots.name: icon
slots.description: The search icon, an InputGroupAddon; clicking it focuses the input.

slots.name: clear
slots.description: The Clear button, hidden while there is nothing to clear; data-slot="input-group-button".

states.name: hover
states.description: Pointer over the Clear button: color.interactive.hover and color.fg.default.

states.name: focus-visible
states.description: Keyboard focus in the input: a ring of ring.width in color.ring around the frame.

states.name: invalid
states.description: In an invalid Field (or with aria-invalid): the frame's border is color.status.danger.border.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Ignores interaction; the frame dims to opacity.disabled.

accessibility: The text control is a native <input type="search"> (role searchbox); name it with a FieldLabel or aria-label, not only a placeholder.
The Clear button is a native <button> named "Clear search"; it returns focus to the input. Escape clears as well, and is left to the page (a dialog) when the box is empty.
Announce how many results match in a role="status" element next to it; the box itself does not.
The search icon is decorative (aria-hidden) and clicking it focuses the input.
Focus shows a ring of ring.width in color.ring (3:1 on every surface).
